result.topic_en: A pencil drawing of a tilted square lattice overlaid on a grid of dots, with lattice cells labelled by the residues 0, 1, 2, 3 and marks × and ·, apparently illustrating a geometric representation of biquadratic residue characters in the Gaussian integers.
result.transcription:
[Drawing: tilted grid of squares inside a polygon on a dotted lattice; cells marked with digits 0, 1, 2, 3 and symbols × and ·]

Cell labels as legible (approximately row by row along the tilted grid, top to bottom):
× 1 0 2
0 2 × 3 · × 1
2 3 × × 0 × 2 ×
× 1 0 × 1 2 × 1
0 1 × × 0 ×
2 3 × 1 3
× 3 × 0 × 2 1
× 2 0 × 1 × 3 0
1 × 0 × 2 × 1 3
2 1 × 0 × 2 ×
1 × 2 3 × 1
2 0

methods.what: Geometric depiction of residue classes (labels 0–3, i.e. biquadratic character indices) on a rotated square lattice of Gaussian integers, with × marking lattice points of a sublattice
